summary: Pop Culture Group Co. filed a 6-K reporting the closing on September 24, 2026 of a registered direct offering of up to 665,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$3.00 per share under an existing Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-292982, effective February 9, 2026). The Securities Purchase Agreement was signed September 22, 2026 with a single named investor; a prospectus supplement was filed September 24, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown/equity issuance, not a special situation. Watch liquidity, pricing pressure and any future tranche or resale overhang.
